diagnosis.primary: Metastatic cutaneous melanoma with brain metastases in the left temporal lobe and left basal ganglia.
diagnosis.established: 2022-03-15, excisional biopsy of a back lesion.

presentation.presenting_complaint: One week of worsening headaches, word-finding difficulty, and clumsiness of the right hand.
presentation.hpi_summary: 65M with metastatic melanoma. Two brain metastases were treated with radiosurgery, followed by pembrolizumab, and shrank on the next MRI. Seen in oncology clinic with new headaches, word-finding difficulty, and right-hand clumsiness; dexamethasone started and MRI ordered.

active_problems: Metastatic melanoma with brain metastases, status post radiosurgery, on pembrolizumab.
New headaches, word-finding difficulty, and right-hand clumsiness.

procedures.procedure: Wide local excision of a back lesion

treatments.treatment: Stereotactic radiosurgery to the left temporal and left basal ganglia metastases, 20 Gy in 1 fraction

expected_post_treatment_findings: Post-radiosurgery change at the left temporal and left basal ganglia metastases (2022-07-05).
